papers.title_en: Uniqueness of shrinking Kähler-Ricci solitons on resolutions of Kähler cones
papers.evidence: 关于Kähler-Ricci孤立子的直接结果，是几何偏微分方程的核心主题.
papers.tldr: 关于Kähler锥上的解析空间，研究完备收缩梯度Kähler-Ricci孤立子的唯一性问题。本文证明此类孤立子必定渐近锥形，进而结合Esparza的结果，得出在双全纯拉回意义下至多存在一个这样的孤立子。这证实了Song-Zhang猜想中唯一性部分的特例，并讨论了其他推论。
papers.abstract_en: We show that any complete shrinking gradient Kähler-Ricci soliton on a resolution of a Kähler cone is necessarily asymptotically conical. From a result of Esparza, it then follows that up to pullback by biholomorphism, there exists at most one complete shrinking gradient Kähler-Ricci soliton on such a resolution. This confirms a special case of the uniqueness part of a conjecture of Song-Zhang. Some other consequences are also discussed.

papers.title_en: Mean curvature and sharp Willmore inequalities in metric spaces
papers.evidence: 度量空间中的平均曲率、Willmore泛函与尖锐不等式，属于核心几何PDE主题。
papers.tldr: 在Ricci曲率下有界的非光滑度量空间中，平均曲率的概念长期缺失。本文通过Sobolev函数定义Willmore泛函，并利用切向散度构造水平集的平均曲率向量，证明其满足自然积分公式。作为应用，在具有欧氏体积增长的RCD(0,N)空间中，静电势的几乎所有水平集都具备该平均曲率，且满足与光滑情形相同的Sharp Willmore不等式及刚性/几乎刚性结论。此外还推广了Sharp等容不等式，为非光滑几何分析提供了关键工具。
papers.abstract_en: The goal of this work is to introduce a notion of mean curvature for level sets of functions in non-smooth spaces with Ricci curvature bounded below, and to prove that it satisfies sharp geometric inequalities. More precisely, we define a suitable Willmore functional $\mathcal{W}$ on Sobolev functions, whose domain of finiteness is dense in $L^p$ for any $1\le p<\infty$. For any function with finite Willmore energy, we show that almost all of its level sets admit a mean curvature vector satisfying the natural integration by parts formula with respect to the tangential divergence. As a main application, we show that in ${\rm RCD}(0,N)$ spaces with Euclidean volume growth, almost every level set of the electrostatic potential possesses a mean curvature vector in the above sense. Furthermore, we prove that this vector satisfies the same sharp Willmore inequality as in the smooth setting, alongside rigidity and almost-rigidity statements. Finally, as a technical tool, we generalize the sharp isocapacitary inequality to the non-smooth setting.

papers.title_en: Inviscid Incompressible Limit for Degenerate Compressible Navier-Stokes Equations on Expanding Domains
papers.authors: Tong Tang, Emil Wiedemann, Lu Zhu
papers.evidence: 直接研究退化可压缩Navier-Stokes方程，与复合主题中的NS分量密切相关。
papers.tldr: 针对扩张区域上密度依赖粘度的退化可压缩Navier-Stokes方程，本文同时考察无粘极限与低马赫数极限的联合渐近行为。与常数粘度情形相比，粘度随密度变化导致动量方程中的非线性退化系数给先验估计带来本质困难，需要深入分析区域扩张与退化结构的相互作用。在不规则准备数据框架下，通过引入合适的极限过程与紧凑性论证，证明解的序列收敛到三维不可压Euler方程的解。该结果是首个在密度依赖粘度情形下同时建立无粘与不可压极限的工作，将Feireisl等人关于常数粘度方程的结果推广到退化情形。
papers.abstract_en: We simultaneously investigate the inviscid and Low Mach number limits on expanding domains for the $3D$ degenerate compressible Navier-Stokes equations, whose viscosity depends on density. Starting from ill-prepared data, we show the limit system is the incompressible Euler system.   Our result extends a previous result of Feireisl et al. concerning the constant viscosity Navier-Stokes equations, and is the first to establish the inviscid and incompressible limits at the same time for density-dependent viscosity.

papers.title_en: Positive-regularity norm inflation for the 3D hypodissipative Navier--Stokes equations
papers.evidence: 通过范数膨胀与不适定性涉及Navier-Stokes方程的存在性与正则性.
papers.tldr: 针对三维弱耗散Navier-Stokes方程，研究其正则性范数膨胀现象。通过将各向异性涡环混合机制推广至分数阶耗散，并利用严格缩放超临界间隙控制曲率与非局部耗散误差，证明了在特定Sobolev与Besov空间参数范围内，存在任意小的光滑初值，其对应的唯一局部光滑解能在任意短时间内变得任意大。该结果首次在弱耗散情形实现同空间范数膨胀，完善了Navier-Stokes方程范数膨胀理论。
papers.abstract_en: We prove same-space norm inflation for the three-dimensional hypodissipative Navier--Stokes equations with dissipation $(-Δ)^α$, $0<α<1$. Let $2\le p<\infty$ and \[   0<s<1-2α+\frac3p. \] In the Besov case, let also $1\le q\le\infty$. There exist divergence-free $C_c^\infty(\mathbb R^3)$ initial data that are arbitrarily small in $W^{s,p}$, respectively in $B^s_{p,q}$, while the corresponding unique local smooth solution becomes arbitrarily large in the same space in arbitrarily short time. The proof adapts the anisotropic vortex-ring mixing mechanism to fractional dissipation; the strict scaling-supercritical gap makes both the curvature error and the nonlocal dissipative error perturbative.

papers.title_en: A 'global' Perspective on the Differential Geometry of Wasserstein Spaces
papers.evidence: Wasserstein空间上的全局微分几何框架，与测度空间上的几何分析相关。
papers.tldr: 本文针对闭流形上L²-Wasserstein空间的微分几何，提出基于柱函数导子的全局演算框架。通过该框架，基流形的Levi-Civita联络与黎曼张量得以提升，并证明经典梯度形式中的修正项源于对依赖测度梯度分布的投影，而非内蕴曲率。这一方法重新审视了Lott的平滑计算，得出部分不同结论，为Wasserstein几何提供了全局视角。
papers.abstract_en: We develop a global differential calculus on the $L^2$-Wasserstein space over a closed Riemannian manifold, based on derivations of cylinder functions rather than on the standard pointwise approach. Within this framework we define some fundamental geometric tools. In particular, we show that the Levi-Civita connection on the base manifold lifts to the unique torsion-free connection compatible with the 'extended' Otto metric. The corresponding Riemann tensor is exactly the lift of the base Riemann tensor, which shows that - in this framework - the correction terms of the classical gradient formalism are not intrinsic curvature terms, but arise from the projection onto the measure-dependent gradient distribution. This allows us to revisit with a global and purely differential approach the smooth computations by J. Lott, Comm. Math. Phys., 277(2):423-437, 2007, reaching partially different conclusions.

papers.title_en: On the upper bound for the vorticity growth of bi-rotational Euler flows without swirl
papers.evidence: Euler流的全局适定性与涡量增长，与Navier-Stokes存在性密切相关。
papers.tldr: 针对高维空间中具有双旋转对称且无涡旋的不可压欧拉流，本文研究其涡量增长上界。作者先建立了Yudovich型解的局部适定性，再通过细致的涡量增长率估计，在维度不大于6时证明了解全局存在。关键结果表明，涡量最大值的增长率与轴对称无旋流情形一致，将已有结果推广到了更广泛的双旋转对称类。
papers.abstract_en: For $d\geq 4$, we consider incompressible Euler flows in $\mathbb{R}^{d}$ with bi-rotational symmetry and without swirl. Our first result gives the local wellposedness of the Yudovich-type solution. The second result provides global wellposedness up to $d\leq 6$. In particular, it shows that the rate of growth of the vorticity maximum coincides with the rate from axisymmetric flows without swirl, which was obtained in the paper by the second author and Jeong (Arch. Ration. Mech. Anal. 249(3):32, 2025) and Shao--Wei--Zhang (Acta Math. Sin. (Engl. Ser.), 42(3):663-679, 2026).
